newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Yahoo! estimates, target.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Yahoo! estimates, target.

text.p: -- Credit Suisse First Boston analyst Alan Braverman raised his estimates of Yahoo! Inc's 1997 financial results to a loss of $0.01 a share from a loss of $0.14 a share previously, his associate said.
-- Braverman also raised his 1998 estimate to a net profit of $0.40 a share from a $0.34 a share profit previously.
-- He raised his target price for the stock to 32 within the next 12 months from a previous target of 27-3/4, the assistant said. Braverman himself was not available.
